title: The shared drive link is from the project lead
scenario: A project lead shares a “new secure folder” in chat for confidential launch materials. The link asks you to sign in and approve access to your entire cloud drive.

answers.A: Open the company drive directly and locate the folder, or verify the link with the project lead through another channel.
answers.B: Ask IT/security whether the new storage tool is approved before granting access.
answers.C: Approve because the project lead is trusted and the launch really is confidential.

explanation: Confidentiality language can make broad access sound necessary. A simple folder should not need full-drive permissions.
proTip: More sensitive project means less tolerance for unknown tools.
